label: Acts 3:1
text: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

label: Acts 3:2
text: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

label: Acts 3:3
text: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

label: Acts 3:4
text: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

label: Acts 3:5
text: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

label: Acts 3:6
text: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

label: Acts 3:7
text: He took him by the right hand, and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

label: Acts 3:8
text: Leaping up, he stood, and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

label: Acts 3:9
text: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

label: Acts 3:10
text: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

label: Acts 3:11
text: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

label: Acts 3:12
text: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

label: Acts 3:13
text: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up, and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

label: Acts 3:14
text: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

label: Acts 3:15
text: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

label: Acts 3:16
text: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

label: Acts 3:17
text: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

label: Acts 3:18
text: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

label: Acts 3:19
text: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

label: Acts 3:20
text: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

label: Acts 3:21
text: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

label: Acts 3:22
text: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

label: Acts 3:23
text: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’

label: Acts 3:24
text: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, they also told of these days.

label: Acts 3:25
text: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘In your offspring will all the families of the earth be blessed.’

label: Acts 3:26
text: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”

label: Peter and John went up to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour
statement: Peter and John went up into the temple at 'the hour of prayer, the ninth hour' - the mid-afternoon hour of the daily temple rite, the hour of the afternoon offering.

label: A man lame from birth was carried daily to the temple's Beautiful Gate to beg
statement: A certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried and laid daily at the door of the temple called Beautiful, to ask alms of those who entered; he asked Peter and John for alms.

label: One of the temple doors was called the Beautiful Gate
statement: There was a door (gate) of the temple 'which is called Beautiful' (ten legomenen horaian). Its identification is disputed: candidates are the inner Nicanor Gate and the outer Shushan (Eastern) Gate.

label: Peter healed the lame man in the name of Jesus and he walked into the temple
statement: Peter said 'In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk,' took the man's right hand, and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength; he entered the temple walking, leaping, and praising God. A miracle claim, recorded as such.

label: The people recognized the healed man and were filled with wonder
statement: All the people saw him walking and praising God, recognized him as the man who used to sit begging at the Beautiful Gate of the temple, and were filled with wonder and amazement.

label: The people ran together to Peter and John in the porch called Solomon's
statement: As the healed man held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch (colonnade) that is called Solomon's.

label: Peter accused his hearers of delivering Jesus up before Pilate, who had determined to release him
statement: Peter told the men of Israel they had delivered Jesus up and denied him 'in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.'

label: They asked for a murderer to be granted to them
statement: Peter said they denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to them (Barabbas in the Passion narratives).

label: Peter told the crowd that God raised Jesus and that the apostles were witnesses
statement: Peter told the crowd they killed the Prince of life, 'whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses' - the apostles' proclamation, not an externally checkable event.

label: Peter quoted Moses: God will raise up a prophet like me
statement: Peter quoted Moses to the fathers: 'The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you' (Deuteronomy 18:15, 18).

label: Peter quoted the covenant promise that all families of the earth will be blessed in Abraham's offspring
statement: Peter called his hearers children of the covenant God made with the fathers, 'saying to Abraham, In your offspring will all the families of the earth be blessed' (Genesis 22:18).

label: Wikipedia: Cave of Nicanor (the ossuary of the temple-door maker)
title: Cave of Nicanor
excerpt: Nicanor belonged to a wealthy Alexandrian Jewish family. He is mentioned in the works of the Roman Jewish historian Josephus and the Talmud as the donor of the bronze doors of the Court of the Women in the Second Temple in Jerusalem.

label: Sefaria API: Mishnah Pesachim 5:1
title: Mishnah Pesachim 5:1
excerpt: The daily afternoon offering is slaughtered at eight and a half hours of the day, which is two and a half hours after midday, and is sacrificed, i.e., its offering on the altar is completed, at nine and a half hours of the day.

label: Wikipedia: Beautiful Gate (disputed identification)
title: Beautiful Gate
excerpt: Attempts by scholars to agree on the identity of the gate by one of its recognized names have met with little success although both the upper inner gate, the Nicanor, and the lower outer gate, the Shushan, have been suggested as candidates.
